title: Builder Extended Rate Lock Change Terms Reference
content:
Changes to the loan behind a Builder Extended Rate Lock, and a homesite transfer on the purchase agreement, are governed by these term figures.

| Lock term | Program change fee (percent of the new loan amount) | Program change restarts the lock term | Loan amount rise allowed after lock without re-pricing | Lock survives a homesite transfer on the purchase agreement |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 60-Day Standard Lock | 0.125% | No | 5% | No |
| 90-Day Lock | 0.125% | No | 5% | No |
| 120-Day Extended Lock | 0.125% | No | 5% | No |
| 180-Day Extended Lock | 0.125% | No | 3% | No |
| 270-Day Build Lock | 0.125% | No | 3% | No |
| 360-Day Build Lock | 0.125% | No | 3% | No |

## Column meanings

- **Program change fee** — the fee for changing loan program on a lock, as a percent of the new loan amount.
- **Restarts the lock term** — whether a program change restarts the lock term.
- **Loan amount rise allowed** — the percent the loan amount may rise after lock without re-pricing.
- **Survives a homesite transfer** — whether a lock survives a homesite transfer on the purchase agreement.

The rise allowed is 5% on the 60-Day, 90-Day and 120-Day terms and 3% on the 180-Day Extended Lock and both Build Locks; the other three columns are the same on every term.
